description: generateTransforms (TransformGeneratorLive, transformGenerator.ts) full ordered candidate lists over a shapes x settings matrix (rotation/mirror enablement, transform caps, the adaptive Compact policy on both eligible/ineligible branches, configured/edge-alignment toggles), plus computeTransformedCollisionGeometry (transformCollisionGeometryCore.ts) rotation/mirror point-application results over real mixed61-request.json piece dimensions and synthetic convex shapes, at quarter-turn and arbitrary trig-requiring angles. f64 values are recorded as big-endian IEEE-754 bit-pattern hex strings for bit-exact comparison.
